g.text: Written in the SAME transaction as the business write -- the only table unique to this deep dive
created_at timestamp same txn as the business write
published_at timestamp, nullable set by the relay once sent
Index: published_at (or a partial index WHERE published_at IS NULL)
The relay's entire query: rows where published_at IS NULL, ordered by id.
CDC relay reads unpublished rows -> publishes to Kafka
-> sets published_at. Row is deleted after a short retention
window; this table stays small regardless of write volume.
